request.state: Can zero-user whole-language audit. Compatibility has no veto. Preserve explicit authority, exact math, nominal types, exhaustive outcomes, tests as evidence, no hidden exception propagation. These are proposed surface preferences requiring parser/formatter/proof tests and measured agent trials, not ratification. Current syntax: Seq<T> with ad hoc nesting exclusions, d"0.5" exact decimals, raw "..." and escaped e"...", eager and/or, mandatory type arguments, error-level lint removes in-position names.

local_types.instructions: How should Can handle redundant local type annotations?

criteria.bidirectional: Keep explicit API types, error/effect contracts and ambiguous locals; use deterministic bidirectional/contextual checking for obvious constructor/pattern/local types, never inference from examples.
criteria.everything_explicit: Require explicit type arguments/annotations at every constructor and generic call even when signatures uniquely determine them.
criteria.global_inference: Infer all signatures/errors/effects with no required API annotations.

sequence_types.instructions: Choose collection type spelling on conceptual grounds, not compatibility or fashion.

criteria.uniform_generic: Keep Seq<T>, Map<K,V>, Option<T> as regular compositional type applications; support nesting uniformly.
criteria.bracket_special: Use [T] for sequences and Name<T> for other applications.
criteria.reject_nesting: Keep Seq<T> but keep all present nesting exclusions.

literals.instructions: Choose a proposed literal family for a language with exact int/dec and no binary float.

criteria.conventional_exact: Ordinary decimal tokens such as 12.50 denote exact dec, integers denote int; escaped normal strings and explicitly prefixed raw strings. No coercions, Unicode normalization, or float semantics.
criteria.retain_current: Keep d"12.50", raw ordinary strings and e"..." escaped strings indefinitely.
criteria.binary_float: Make ordinary decimals binary float for host convenience.

booleans.instructions: Recommend boolean evaluation semantics, noting that a change requires explicit coverage rules for implicit branches.

criteria.short_circuit: Use conventional left-to-right short-circuit and/or, model guards explicitly in core IR and specify branch-evidence obligations; do not confuse it with lazy function arguments.
criteria.eager_explicit: Keep and/or eager but make their semantics highly explicit; use match for all guarded evaluation.
criteria.both_spellings: Provide eager and short-circuit variants of both operators.

named_args.instructions: How should the canonical tooling treat useful argument labels?

criteria.preserve_labels: Keep named and positional arguments with one binding rule; preserve labels rather than error-lint away in-position names. Formatter normalizes presentation, not semantic program structure.
criteria.delete_labels: Continue forcing positional arguments whenever the label occupies its declaration slot.
criteria.all_named: Require every call and constructor to spell every argument label.
